subject: Request: hosted API per-1M token rates + model roster
messages:
From: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@deltahealth.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: DeltaHealth Procurement <procurement@deltahealth.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: hosted API per-1M token rates + model roster

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for connecting earlier. DeltaHealth is evaluating hosted LLM providers for a patient-facing summarization feature. To move the vendor screen forward, could you send your standard per-1M token IO rates (separate input vs output), plus a short roster of the hosted models you offer and which models support streaming, tool-calling/function outputs, and embeddings?

Specifically, our procurement team would like:
- List of models available via hosted API (compact names and recommended use cases)
- Per-1M token price (input) and per-1M token price (output) for each model
- Any differences for function-calling payloads or streaming sessions
- Typical latency tiers and whether the models are available in eu-west-1 and us-east-1 (region availability)
- Standard volume discounts (1M, 10M, 100M buckets) and any pilot pricing you offer for proof-of-concept pilots (we anticipate a 3-month pilot ~5M tokens)

I've attached a brief RFI (DeltaHealth_RFI.xlsx) and our signed NDA. If you can get a baseline together today or tomorrow, that would help us finalize the vendor short list. Also copy any pricing/finance contacts who should see the numbers.

Best,
Samantha Cho
Head of Data Products
DeltaHealth
[signed: Samantha Cho]

Attachments: DeltaHealth_RFI.xlsx, Signed_NDA.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@deltahealth.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: hosted API per-1M token rates + model roster

Hi Samantha — thanks for the RFI and the NDA, received and reviewed. Quick baseline below to get you unblocked; happy to run through these on a call and produce a formal quote.

Baseline hosted IO rates (list pricing, per 1M tokens):
- redwood-1.2b (low-latency / NLU): input $12.00 per 1M, output $18.00 per 1M
- redwood-7b (balanced): input $28.00 per 1M, output $42.00 per 1M
- redwood-70b-quant (high-quality / long context): input $95.00 per 1M, output $140.00 per 1M
- open-adapter-13b (cost-efficient): input $15.00 per 1M, output $22.00 per 1M

Notes:
- Streaming responses are supported for all hosted models above; function-calling adds a marginal processing delta we bill as output tokens (no separate surcharge by default).
- Embeddings are a separate SKU; the current list price is $35.00 per 1M embedding input vectors for our embedding-1-small and $65.00 per 1M for embedding-1-large.
- Region availability: redwood-1.2b and redwood-7b are available in us-east-1 and eu-west-1 today; redwood-70b-quant is generally available in us-east-1 with eu availability on request (we can onboard to eu-west-1 with a 2–4 week lead if needed).

Volume discount guidance (standard):
- 0–1M: list rates above
- 1M–10M: 10% off list
- 10M–100M: 18% off list
- >100M: tiered pricing and committed-rate ARR discussion (we'll propose custom tiers)

Pilot offer (3-month PoC ~5M tokens): we can extend a one-time pilot credit of 25% off list for the first 5M tokens (applies to both input and output), subject to a short PoC SOW and a light commitment to a discovery cadence.

I've CC'd Ben (AE) and Laura (Finance) who will help with a formal commercial. If you want a quick 30-minute call to walk through model tradeoffs and expected unit economics for your workload, I'm available tomorrow between 11:00–15:00 PT.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0192

Attachment references: none

From: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@deltahealth.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: DeltaHealth Procurement <procurement@deltahealth.ai>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: hosted API per-1M token rates + model roster

Thanks, Karthik — this is very helpful. A couple of clarifying items before we sync:

- Our initial PoC will target clinical note summarization and triage prompts; the summaries average ~120 input tokens and ~300 output tokens. Can you confirm whether the pilot credit would apply proportionally across input/output token splits?
- We will need EU data residency for production. Can you confirm concrete timelines and any uplift for hosting the 70b model in eu-west-1?
- For the pilot, are there any soft caps on concurrent streaming sessions or burst limits we should know about?
- Please also confirm whether your standard contract includes data retention settings (we typically need 30-day full logs and option to disable persistent KV caching).

We've attached a short PoC requirements doc (delta_poc_requirements.docx) to give you expected traffic patterns so you can model cost. If possible, could you send a one-page commercial (PDF) that shows list vs pilot pricing and the recommended model for accuracy vs cost? That will help procurement and clinical leadership.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Samantha

Attachments: delta_poc_requirements.docx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: hosted API per-1M token rates + model roster — propose pilot pricing

Ben, Laura — forwarding DeltaHealth's RFI and follow-up. Quick internal note and suggested approach: 

Summary of ask: baseline per-1M IO rates + model availability in eu-west-1; pilot (~5M tokens) with proportional credit; production residency requirement (EU).

Suggested commercial posture:
- Use redwood-7b as recommended PoC model (good balance accuracy/cost for summarization).
- Apply the pilot credit as 25% off total tokens consumed during pilot, applied proportionally to input/output charges.
- Offer soft burst allowance: 2x nominal concurrency during pilot (no additional charge unless sustained >7 days).
- For EU residency: propose 70b in eu-west-1 as an elevated-setup option with a one-time $10k deployment onboarding fee and a 2–4 week setup SLA. Offer redwood-7b in eu-west-1 within 5 business days as immediate option.

Action items:
- Laura: can you draft a 1-page commercial that shows (a) list pricing, (b) pilot pricing with 25% credit applied to a 5M token scenario using DeltaHealth's token split example, and (c) committed 12-month discount ladder? Please include the one-time onboarding fee as a line item for the 70b eu deployment.
- Ben: please schedule a 30-minute scoping call with Samantha and her team tomorrow; propose 11:30 PT or 14:00 PT.

I'll include the DeltaHealth RFI and PoC doc in the formal quote.

-Karthik
